notes.title: 🎵 Update Announcement: 10 New Songs Added
notes.content:
[p]Dear players,[/p][p]Thank you so much for the love and support you've shown for [b]GridFiller[/b].
What started as a small puzzle game has become something more meaningful — a quiet space that many of you turn to for a moment of calm in your busy lives. That means the world to us.[/p][p]To make that space a little warmer, we've added [b]10 new music tracks[/b] to the game.
These songs are gentle, reflective, and designed to accompany your journey — whether you're solving puzzles, unwinding after a long day, or simply letting your mind wander.[/p][p]We hope they help you slow down, breathe, and enjoy the quiet in between the noise.[/p][p]Thank you for playing,
— The GridFiller Team[/p]
